name: Gridfinity drawer builder
description: Fits a Gridfinity baseplate and bins to a drawer, cut to your printer's bed, and saves the whole set as one model.
author: Thingport contributors

screenshots.caption: A 500 × 400 mm drawer: the baseplate cut into six tiles for a 256 mm bed, with bins of several sizes and heights, some with compartments.
The same drawer in the dark theme, with a baseplate tile in the 3D view: drag it to turn it round.
Cells stretched to fill a small drawer exactly, and what's wrong flagged: a bin too big for the bed, another taller than the drawer.
